tex_content.label: qeqn
tex_content.source:
\begin{equation}
\label{qeqn}
  q\gg(4+A_0)^2,
  \qquad
  \frac{q^2}{s^4}e^{-q/s}\ll1
  \quad(0<s\leq4+A_0).
\end{equation}
After choosing $C_0$, require $\delta\ll C_0^{-1}$; then
\[
  \frac q{s^2}f^2\ll\frac{q^2}{s^4}f^2
  \ll\frac q{s^2}f\ll1.
\]

\begin{corollary}[Curvature formula for the conformally rescaled neck metric]
